description: This source file defines a custom Android UI component named ContinueWatchingCard, which displays a thumbnail, progress bar, and title, optimized for Android TV D-pad navigation. The class includes detailed layout specifications, handles focus animations, RTL support, and visual customization to meet specific design requirements.

classes.name: ContinueWatchingCard
classes.description: A custom CardView for displaying a continue watching item with thumbnail, progress, and title. Supports focus animations, RTL layout, and precise UI design specifications.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a ContentItem object to the view, updating the title and progress fill based on the item's state.

methods.name: applyProgressToFill
methods.description: Adjusts the width of the progress fill indicator according to the progress fraction.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels (dp) to pixel units.
